maya: Quick sync — PR #36721 is ready for merge but CI is failing one flaky UI snapshot on mac-11 (toolbar_render_spec). It passes locally for me but CI shows 1/10 failures. Can someone approve a targeted rerun while I dig into the snapshot? @kevin @lina
kevin: Link? also which shard exactly?
maya: https://ci.redwood/36721/build/422 — failing on ui-mac-11 shard (toolbar_render_spec).
ci-bot: Build 36721 failed on ui-mac-11: toolbar_render_spec (flaky). Rerun tokens remaining: 2.
lina: If history is 9/10 passes i'm fine with a targeted rerun. Approved for a single rerun, but no LGTM until green. @sam can you eyeball the snapshot diff if it comes back?
sam: Happy to. Quick glance at the artifact shows a small padding change — could be CSS drift from the recent toolbar refactor. If rerun fails consistently i'll update the snapshot in the PR.
maya: OK running a targeted rerun now: ```/rerun --pr=36721 --shards=ui-mac-11```
ci-bot: Rerun queued for PR 36721 (ui-mac-11). This thread will be updated with results.
kevin: If it flakes again, consider pinning the test with a short skip and follow up with a patch, or we revert the CSS tweak if it's high risk.
ci-bot: Rerun finished — PASS. All checks green for PR 36721 :tada:
lina: LGTM, feel free to merge when the queue allows. Please add a short note in the PR describing the flake and follow-up plan to update snapshot if it reappears.
maya: Will add a note and merge shortly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
